articles.title_en: Voter coordination in elections: A case for approval voting
articles.title_cn: 选举中的选民协调：赞成投票的一个案例
articles.abstract_en: We study how voting rules shape voter coordination in large three-candidate elections. We consider three rules, that differ on the number of candidates that voters can support: Plurality (one), Anti-Plurality (two) and Approval Voting (one or two). We show that the Condorcet winner is always elected at some equilibrium under Approval Voting, and that this rule provides better welfare guarantees than Plurality. We then numerically study a dynamic process of political tâtonnement which delivers rich insights. The Condorcet winner is virtually always elected under Approval Voting, but not under the other rules. The dominance of Approval Voting is robust to several alternative welfare criteria and the introduction of expressive voters.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究投票规则如何塑造大型三候选人选举中的选民协调。我们考虑三种规则，它们在选民可以支持的候选人数量上有所不同： plurality（一）、anti-plurality（二）和 approval voting（一或二）。我们表明，在赞成投票下，孔多塞赢家总是在某个均衡下当选，并且该规则比 plurality 提供更好的福利保障。然后，我们数值研究了一个政治试探的动态过程，该过程提供了丰富的见解。在赞成投票下，孔多塞赢家几乎总是当选，但在其他规则下则不然。赞成投票的支配地位对于几种替代福利标准和表达性选民的引入是稳健的。

articles.title_en: The Texas Shoot-Out under Knightian uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 奈特不确定性下的得克萨斯枪决机制
articles.abstract_en: We investigate a widely used mechanism to resolve disputes among business partners, known as Texas Shoot-Out, under Knightian uncertainty. For a non-degenerate range of intermediate valuations, an ambiguity-averse divider truthfully reveals their valuation in equilibrium. As a consequence, the resulting outcome is efficient, in contrast to the Bayesian case. With equal shares, both agents prefer ex-ante to be the chooser and would like to avoid triggering the mechanism in the first place.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在商业伙伴间解决争议的一种广泛使用的机制，即得克萨斯枪决机制，在奈特不确定性下的表现。对于中间估值的一个非退化区间，厌恶模糊性的分割者在均衡中真实地揭示其估值。因此，与贝叶斯情形相反，所得结果是有效的。在股份相等的情况下，两个代理人都在事前偏好成为选择者，并希望首先避免触发该机制。

articles.title_en: Not all is lost: Sorting and self-stabilizing sets
articles.title_cn: 并非全盘皆输：排序与自稳定集合
articles.abstract_en: It is well known that in the absence of transfers, stable matchings are positive assortative when agents' preferences are strictly monotonic in each other's types and types are commonly known. Instead, monotonicity is consistent with the existence of stable matchings that exhibit negative sorting when types on one side of the market are private information. This paper sheds light on the scope and meaning of this consistency by showing that within familiar monotonic markets we cannot conclude that a stable matching is negative, and not positive, assortative.
articles.abstract_cn: 众所周知，在没有转移支付的情况下，当代理人的偏好严格单调于彼此的类型且类型为共同知识时，稳定匹配是正分类匹配。相反，当市场一方的类型为私人信息时，单调性与存在表现出负分类的稳定匹配是一致的。本文通过表明在熟悉的单调市场中，我们不能断定稳定匹配是负分类而非正分类的，从而阐明了这种一致性的范围和含义。

articles.title_en: Multilateral bargaining over the division of losses
articles.abstract_en: Many-player divide-the-dollar (DD) games have been a workhorse in the theoretical and experimental analysis of multilateral bargaining. If we deal with a loss or consider many-player divide-the-penalty (DP) games, the theoretical predictions are not simply those from DD games with the sign flipped. We show that the stationary stage-undominated equilibrium (SSUE) is no longer unique in payoffs. The most “egalitarian” equilibrium among the stationary equilibria is a mirror image of the essentially unique SSUE in the Baron–Ferejohn model. That equilibrium's allocations are sensitive to changes in parameters, while the most “unequal” equilibrium is less affected by such changes. Experimental evidence supports the most unequal equilibrium: Most of the approved proposals under a majority rule involve an extreme allocation of the loss to a few members. Other observations such as no delay, the proposer advantage, and the acceptance rate are also consistent with predictions based on the most unequal equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 多人分美元（DD）博弈一直是多边谈判理论与实验分析中的主要工具。若我们处理损失或考虑多人分罚金（DP）博弈，理论预测并非简单地将DD博弈的结果符号翻转。我们表明，平稳阶段无支配均衡（SSUE）在收益上不再唯一。在平稳均衡中，最“平等”的均衡是Baron–Ferejohn模型中本质上唯一的SSUE的镜像。该均衡的分配对参数变化敏感，而最“不平等”的均衡受此类变化影响较小。实验证据支持最不平等的均衡：多数规则下，大多数被批准的提案涉及将损失极端分配给少数成员。其他观察结果，如无延迟、提议者优势和接受率，也与基于最不平等均衡的预测一致。

articles.abstract_en: An administrator is provided with data collected by several practitioners. These data may include inconclusive observations. The administrator is required to form a frequency distribution on the states of nature that would be approved by external auditors as long as it is compatible with the available information. We state a novel result on the compatibility of a probability with a finite set of capacities. We use this result to provide necessary and sufficient conditions for the compatibility of the administrator's frequency distribution with the data collected by the practitioners, according to two auditing criteria.
articles.abstract_cn: 管理者获得由多位从业者收集的数据。这些数据可能包含不确定的观测结果。管理者需要形成一个关于自然状态的频率分布，只要该分布与可用信息兼容，外部审计师就会予以批准。我们提出了关于概率与有限容量集兼容性的一个新结果。我们利用这一结果，根据两种审计标准，为管理者的频率分布与从业者收集的数据的兼容性提供了必要且充分的条件。

articles.title_en: On the manipulability of allocation rules through endowment augmentation
articles.title_cn: 论通过增加禀赋操纵配置规则的可能性
articles.abstract_en: We formulate and study the requirement on an allocation rule that no agent should be able to benefit by artificially augmenting their endowment. This can be either through simply exaggeration or through a transfer of resources from outside of the current trading partners, resources that have to be returned after the rule is applied and the agent has received their assignment. We show that the Walrasian rule is not “augmentation-proof” even on standard domains. More seriously, no efficient selection from the individual-endowments lower bounds correspondence, or from the no-envy correspondence, or from the egalitarian-equivalent correspondence is augmentation-proof. These impossibilities hold even when preferences are homothetic, and even if the agent cannot augment their endowment by more than an arbitrarily small proportion of the resources they truly own.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出并研究配置规则的一个要求，即任何代理人都不应能够通过人为增加其禀赋而获益。这既可以通过简单的夸大，也可以通过从当前交易伙伴之外转移资源来实现，这些资源在规则应用且代理人收到其分配后必须归还。我们表明，即使在标准域上，瓦尔拉斯规则也不是“防增加”的。更严重的是，来自个人禀赋下界对应、无嫉妒对应或平等等价对应的任何有效选择都不是防增加的。这些不可能性即使在偏好是同位的，并且即使代理人不能将其禀赋增加超过其实际拥有资源的任意小比例时也成立。

articles.title_en: Integrating Raiffa and Nash approaches to bargaining using interim agreements
articles.title_cn: 利用临时协议整合Raiffa与Nash谈判方法
articles.abstract_en: Raiffa's solution to the bargaining problem, outlined in Luce and Raiffa (1957), is the point where the negotiation curve - a sequence of points that constitute step-by-step improvements from the status quo in the feasible payoff space - meets (possibly in the limit) the efficient boundary of the feasible region. A bargaining model with interim agreements yields a negotiation curve in equilibrium (in the spirit of Raiffa), and as the bargaining frictions disappear, the Raiffa path of payoffs converges to the Nash solution.
articles.abstract_cn: Raiffa对谈判问题的解法，在Luce和Raiffa（1957）中概述，是谈判曲线——在可行收益空间中从现状逐步改进的一系列点——与可行区域的有效边界相交（可能是在极限情况下）的点。一个带有临时协议的谈判模型在均衡中产生一条谈判曲线（遵循Raiffa的精神），并且随着谈判摩擦的消失，Raiffa收益路径收敛于Nash解。

articles.title_en: Fairness and competition in a bilateral matching market
articles.title_cn: 双边匹配市场中的公平与竞争
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes fairness and bargaining in a dynamic bilateral matching market. Traders from both sides of the market are pairwise matched to share the gains from trade. The bargaining outcome depends on the traders' fairness attitudes. In equilibrium fairness matters because of market frictions. But, when these frictions become negligible, the equilibrium approaches the Walrasian competitive equilibrium, independently of the traders' inequity aversion. Fairness may yield a Pareto improvement; but also the contrary is possible. Overall, the market implications of fairness are very different from its effects in isolated bilateral bargaining.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了动态双边匹配市场中的公平与讨价还价。来自市场双方的交易者被两两匹配以分享贸易收益。讨价还价的结果取决于交易者的公平态度。在均衡中，公平之所以重要是因为市场摩擦。但是，当这些摩擦变得可以忽略时，均衡趋近于瓦尔拉斯竞争均衡，与交易者的不平等厌恶无关。公平可能带来帕累托改进；但也可能相反。总体而言，公平的市场影响与其在孤立双边讨价还价中的效应非常不同。

articles.title_en: Folk theorems in repeated games with switching costs
articles.title_cn: 带转换成本的重复博弈中的民间定理
articles.abstract_en: We study how switching costs affect the subgame perfect equilibria in repeated games. We show that (i) the Folk Theorem holds whenever the players are patient enough; (ii) the set of equilibrium payoffs is obtained by considering the payoffs of a simple one-shot auxiliary game; and (iii) the switching costs have a negative impact on a player in the infinitely undiscounted repeated game but can be beneficial for him in a finitely repeated game or in a discounted game.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究转换成本如何影响重复博弈中的子博弈完美均衡。我们证明：(i) 只要参与者足够有耐心，民间定理成立；(ii) 均衡收益集可通过考虑一个简单的一次性辅助博弈的收益获得；(iii) 在无限无折现重复博弈中，转换成本对参与者有负面影响，但在有限重复博弈或折现博弈中可能对他有利。

articles.title_cn: 信号相关下的信念形成
articles.abstract_en: This paper demonstrates the importance of considering incorrect perceptions of variance in characterizing people's belief formation rules when they suffer from correlation neglect. Using laboratory experiments, we elicit posterior beliefs regarding the realization of a random variable where some signals that a subject receives are correlated. Subjects in our experiments consistently neglect correlation and also misperceive signal variance when updating their beliefs. We present behavioral models that illustrate how people who suffer from both biases overvalue strongly correlated signals and undervalue weakly correlated signals relative to Bayesian predictions. Additional experiments provide strong support for such a nuanced impact of correlation neglect on belief updating rules. The estimated model parameters are consistent with subjects showing high levels of correlation neglect and undersensitivity to increases in the true variance. Moreover, we find significant heterogeneity across subjects, with a majority exhibiting correlation neglect combined with variance misperception.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文论证了在个体遭受相关性忽视时，考虑方差错误感知对于刻画其信念形成规则的重要性。通过实验室实验，我们引出了关于随机变量实现的后验信念，其中受试者接收到的某些信号是相关的。实验中的受试者在更新信念时始终忽视相关性，并且错误感知信号方差。我们提出了行为模型，说明同时遭受这两种偏差的人相对于贝叶斯预测，会高估强相关信号并低估弱相关信号。额外的实验为相关性忽视对信念更新规则的这种细微影响提供了强有力的支持。估计的模型参数与受试者表现出高程度的相关性忽视和对真实方差增加的不敏感性相一致。此外，我们发现受试者之间存在显著的异质性，大多数表现出相关性忽视与方差错误感知的结合。

articles.title_en: Efficiency and maximality in anonymous two-sided economies
articles.title_cn: 匿名双边经济中的效率与最大性
articles.abstract_en: We study efficiency and maximality in anonymous two-sided economies, where each agent only cares about trading with a desired number of partners from the opposite side. For both homogeneous and heterogeneous economies, we provide a necessary and sufficient condition that ensures the efficiency of all pairwise stable matchings. In addition, we provide a sufficient condition for maximality in heterogeneous economies. These conditions have implications for the design of anonymous markets that function optimally without the continuous intervention of a social planner.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究匿名双边经济中的效率与最大性，其中每个代理人只关心与对方期望数量的伙伴进行交易。对于同质和异质经济，我们提供了一个必要且充分的条件，确保所有成对稳定匹配的效率。此外，我们为异质经济中的最大性提供了一个充分条件。这些条件对匿名市场的设计具有启示意义，这些市场无需社会规划者的持续干预即可最优运行。

articles.title_en: Differentiating roles of the reference alternative
articles.title_cn: 区分参考替代方案的不同角色
articles.abstract_en: This article explores the behavioral implications of different roles of the reference alternative. We delineate the boundaries of three reference-dependent choice models, each associated with distinct behavioral patterns: the endowment effect model, the loss aversion model, and the reference-dependent shortlisting model. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the intersections of these models correspond to meaningful special cases within each model.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了参考替代方案不同角色的行为含义。我们描绘了三种参考依赖选择模型的边界，每种模型都与不同的行为模式相关联：禀赋效应模型、损失厌恶模型和参考依赖的候选名单模型。此外，我们证明了这些模型的交集对应于每个模型中有意义的特殊情况。

articles.title_en: Bayesian Nash equilibrium in all-pay auctions with interdependent types
articles.title_cn: 相互依赖类型下全支付拍卖中的贝叶斯纳什均衡
articles.abstract_en: We prove the existence of a behavioral-strategy Bayesian Nash equilibrium in all-pay auctions with statistically interdependent types (signals) under quite general assumptions on the values, costs and tie-breaking rules. Moreover, the set of equilibria is shown to be the same for any tie-breaking rule used in the auction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们证明了在价值、成本和打破平局规则相当一般的假设下，具有统计上相互依赖的类型（信号）的全支付拍卖中存在行为策略贝叶斯纳什均衡。此外，均衡集被证明对于拍卖中使用的任何打破平局规则都是相同的。

articles.title_en: Characterizing the typewise top-trading-cycles mechanism for multiple-type housing markets
articles.title_cn: 刻画多类型住房市场中的类型内顶级交易循环机制
articles.abstract_en: We consider the generalization of the classical Shapley and Scarf housing market model (Shapley and Scarf, 1974) to so-called multiple-type housing markets (Moulin, 1995). Throughout the paper, we focus on strict preferences. When preferences are separable, the prominent solution for these markets is the typewise top-trading-cycles (tTTC) mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将经典的Shapley和Scarf住房市场模型（Shapley和Scarf，1974）推广到所谓的多类型住房市场（Moulin，1995）。在整篇论文中，我们关注严格偏好。当偏好是可分离的时，这些市场的突出解决方案是类型内顶级交易循环（tTTC）机制。

articles.title_en: How alliances form and conflict ensues
articles.title_cn: 联盟如何形成与冲突如何产生
articles.abstract_en: In a social network in which friendly and rival bilateral links can be formed, how do alliances between decision-makers form, and what determines whether a conflict will arise? We study a network formation game between ex-ante symmetric players in the laboratory to examine the dynamics of alliance formation and conflict evolution. A peaceful equilibrium yields the greatest social welfare, while a successful bullying attack transfers the victimized player's resources evenly to the attackers at a cost. In within-subject and between-subject laboratory experiments, we find that the relative frequency of peaceful and bullying outcomes increases in the cost of attack. We further examine the dynamics leading to the final network and find that groups tend to coordinate quickly on a first target for attack, while the first attacker entails a non-negligible risk of successful counter-attack. These findings provide insights for understanding social dynamics in group coordination.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个可以形成友好和敌对双边联系的社会网络中，决策者之间的联盟如何形成，以及什么决定了冲突是否会发生？我们在实验室中研究了一个事前对称参与者之间的网络形成博弈，以考察联盟形成和冲突演化的动态。和平均衡产生最大的社会福利，而成功的欺凌攻击会以一定成本将受害者的资源平均转移给攻击者。在受试者内和受试者间的实验室实验中，我们发现和平与欺凌结果的相对频率随攻击成本的增加而增加。我们进一步考察了导致最终网络的动态，发现群体倾向于迅速协调第一个攻击目标，而第一个攻击者则面临不可忽视的遭到成功反击的风险。这些发现为理解群体协调中的社会动态提供了见解。

articles.title_cn: 学校选择中的容量设计
articles.abstract_en: We study a new variant of the school choice problem in which capacities can be altered by distributing additional seats across schools in response to students' reported preferences. We show that heuristic solutions to this capacity design problem can be inefficient, even if they focus on allocating seats to the most demanded schools. We introduce a simple class of algorithms that, in the problem where additional seats can be distributed, characterizes the set of efficient matchings among those that respect priorities. We also investigate the incentive properties of this class of efficient algorithms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了学校选择问题的一个新变体，在该变体中，可以根据学生报告的偏好，通过在学校之间分配额外座位来调整容量。我们表明，即使启发式解决方案侧重于将座位分配给需求最高的学校，它们也可能是低效的。我们引入了一类简单的算法，在可以分配额外座位的问题中，这些算法刻画了尊重优先权的有效匹配集合。我们还研究了这类有效算法的激励性质。

articles.title_en: Social learning with partial and aggregate information: Experimental evidence
articles.title_cn: 部分与总体信息下的社会学习：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: In our information cascade experiments, we study social learning in decision-making situations in which decisions “not to do” are unobservable. Subjects, in sequence, choose whether to invest or not, without knowing their position. They observe a private signal and the number of investments made by their predecessors, but not how many predecessors have chosen not to invest. We find that down cascades, in which agents neglect the signal and do not invest, occur, in contrast with the equilibrium predictions. Up cascades, in which agents invest independently of the signal, occur, but less than in equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 在我们的信息级联实验中，我们研究了在“不行动”决策不可观察的决策情境中的社会学习。受试者按顺序选择是否投资，而不知道自己的位置。他们观察到一个私人信号以及前人所做的投资数量，但不知道有多少前人选择不投资。我们发现，与均衡预测相反，下行级联（即代理人忽视信号且不投资）会发生。上行级联（即代理人独立于信号进行投资）也会发生，但少于均衡状态下的情况。

articles.title_en: Posted offers with charitable promises: True preferences and strategic behavior
articles.title_cn: 带有慈善承诺的报价：真实偏好与策略行为
articles.abstract_en: We report experimental findings on the role of charitable promises in settings with posted offers. We vary the enforceability of such promises within variants of ultimatum games where the proposer suggests a split between herself, the responder and a charitable donation. By reneging on initial pledges, dishonest proposers can change the final allocation to their advantage. Providing ex post information on actual donations while leaving the contract incomplete outperforms a complete contract where proposers cannot renege on their charitable promises. The ex post information allows proposers to improve their image by voluntarily giving more than pledged and thus proving that the charitable pledge was not used for strategic reasons. We identify proposer competition as another (surprising) mechanism that partly eliminates cheating among accepted offers, but it also favors offers without charitable pledge.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们报告了在报价设定中慈善承诺作用的实验结果。我们在最后通牒博弈的变体中变化此类承诺的可执行性，其中提议者建议在自身、回应者和慈善捐赠之间进行分配。通过违背初始承诺，不诚实的提议者可以改变最终分配以利于自己。在合同不完整的情况下，提供关于实际捐赠的事后信息，优于提议者不能违背其慈善承诺的完整合同。事后信息允许提议者通过自愿捐赠超过承诺金额来改善自身形象，从而证明慈善承诺并非出于策略原因。我们识别出提议者竞争作为另一种（令人惊讶的）机制，部分消除了已接受报价中的欺骗，但它也偏向于没有慈善承诺的报价。
